page_title: WOL 1-0 BOC | Wolfsburg v Bochum 20/04/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+8' Corner kick. Wolfsburg will have an opportunity.
90+7' Relief for Kevin Stoger (Bochum) as the ref sticks to his original yellow card decision after the VAR review.

90+7' It's been a while since that contentious challenge by Kevin Stoger (Bochum), but referee Tobias Reichel must have received some information as he makes the VAR signal. He's going to review and it could result in a red card!
90+5' Kevin Stoger (Bochum) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
90+4' Yannick Gerhardt (Wolfsburg) takes a short free kick.
90+2' Ralph Hasenhuttl has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Mattias Svanberg (Wolfsburg) replacing Maximilian Arnold.
90' The fourth official shows 9 min. of added time.
87' Here comes a substitution. Philipp Forster (Bochum) is brought on as a substitute for Patrick Osterhage.
86' Christopher Antwi-Adjei (Bochum) is shown a yellow card by the referee for making a challenge on his opponent, but he looks angry with the decision.
85' Yellow card. Aster Vranckx (Wolfsburg) goes into the book for a bad tackle on his opponent.
85' Moritz Broschinski (Bochum) does his best to latch onto a cross into the box, but he can't get to the ball. The ball goes out of play and Wolfsburg will have a goal kick.
83' Neat passing move from Bochum in order to create new attacking opportunities.
81' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Felix Passlack as he is replaced by Moritz Broschinski (Bochum).
80' Maximilian Arnold (Wolfsburg) takes the resulting corner which is well defended.
79' Christopher Antwi-Adjei (Bochum) is caught offside by the linesman and it looks like it is the right decision despite being a very close call.
76' The attendance is 20000.
75' Kilian Fischer will be replaced by Jakub Kaminski (Wolfsburg).
73' Lukas Daschner (Bochum) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Pavao Pervan, who smothers the ball.
71' The current number of shots on goal is 4:1.
68' Heiko Butscher has decided to make a change. Maximilian Wittek (Bochum) replaces Matus Bero.
68' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Lukas Daschner (Bochum) comes onto the pitch for Anthony Losilla.
68' Tobias Reichel has issued a yellow card to Kevin Paredes (Wolfsburg).

68' Sebastiaan Bornauw (Wolfsburg) looks very eager to impress, does well to beat his man and force a cross into the box, where one of his teammates gets his head on the ball, but it's too easy for the keeper.
68' Wolfsburg get a corner.
67' Amin Sarr (Wolfsburg) shakes off the attention of a defender and from mid-range lets fly towards the middle of the goal, but Manuel Riemann is well positioned to make a comfortable save.
65' Ralph Hasenhuttl prepares a substitution. Jonas Wind is replaced by Kevin Behrens (Wolfsburg).
65' Ralph Hasenhuttl has decided to substitute Tiago Tomas and he is replaced by Kevin Paredes (Wolfsburg).
65' Substitution. Amin Sarr (Wolfsburg) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Ridle Baku walks off.
63' Kevin Stoger (Bochum) looks like he will be the one to take the corner kick.
62' Kevin Stoger (Bochum) will try to find the head of one of his teammates from a corner kick.
61' A dangerous looking corner kick from Kevin Stoger (Bochum) is cleared to safety by the defence.
60' Bernardo (Bochum) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Tobias Reichel blows his whistle for an infringement.
55' Kilian Fischer (Wolfsburg) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
54' Bochum are awarded a free kick near the side line and the players make their way into the box for the inevitable cross.
53' Tiago Tomas (Wolfsburg) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.
52' Corner kick. Kevin Stoger (Bochum) is ready to send the ball into the box.
52' Bochum have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
49' Tiago Tomas (Wolfsburg) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Manuel Riemann intercepts the ball.
46' Heiko Butscher makes a half-time substitution. Christopher Antwi-Adjei comes on in place of Takuma Asano (Bochum).
46' The second half has just started.
45+5' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+3' Kevin Stoger (Bochum) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away.
45' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.

43' 1 - 0 Goal! Jonas Wind (Wolfsburg) picks up the ball from a rebound and from the edge of the box he unleashes a low shot into the bottom right corner. Manuel Riemann is unable to keep the ball out of the net. It's 1:0.
40' Here comes the VAR verdict. NO GOAL for Bochum due to an offside in the build-up play.
40' Hold on! There’s a VAR review to see whether there was an offside in the build up to the goal. The referee is checking now. The Bochum players aren’t happy.
39' Patrick Osterhage (Bochum) gets to the ball after a big mistake by the defending player and scores with a precise shot into the roof of the net.
38' Kevin Stoger (Bochum) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.
38' Bochum failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
37' Sebastiaan Bornauw (Wolfsburg) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
36' Bernardo (Bochum) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Tobias Reichel who sees an offensive foul.

32' A defence-splitting pass is taken in his stride by Takuma Asano (Bochum) in the box. Without even looking up he drills a shot towards the middle of the goal, but Pavao Pervan pulls off an easy save.
32' A mid-range free kick is awarded to Bochum out wide and from this angle a cross into the box is likely.

28' Ambitious effort from Patrick Osterhage (Bochum). He finds himself in a great position after collecting a precise pass inside the penalty area and goes for goal, but it never troubles the goalkeeper and flies well wide of the right post.
26' Tiago Tomas (Wolfsburg) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
25' Tiago Tomas (Wolfsburg) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
24' It seemed like Maximilian Arnold (Wolfsburg) was going to take a quick free kick, but instead he is going to send the ball inside the penalty box for his teammates.
20' Tiago Tomas (Wolfsburg) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
17' The game is interrupted as Takuma Asano (Bochum) is flagged offside.
15' Kevin Stoger (Bochum) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
13' Ridle Baku (Wolfsburg) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety.
12' Patrick Osterhage (Bochum) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.
10' Sebastiaan Bornauw (Wolfsburg) has a great chance on the edge of the six-yard box following a lofted pass, but his header lacks accuracy and flies just past the right post.
8' This corner kick is taken with a short pass by Ridle Baku (Wolfsburg).
7' Matus Bero (Bochum) commits an ugly challenge. The referee sees it and immediately blows his whistle.
4' Maxence Lacroix (Wolfsburg) sends an accurate short pass. Ridle Baku controls the ball with a fine first touch and is able to come up with a new attacking effort.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
Bochum will kick the game off.
Tobias Reichel was nominated as the referee for this game.
